title: console: the shared-record page renders authored field labels, picklist labels, currency and lookups from the share-link resolve answer's new `fields` projection
body:
Filing gate: ② follow-up work owed by landed work. #26991 (server half, PR #27107, merged at 06:52Z on 2026-10-28) gave the share-link resolve answer the field display projection that #26767's shared-record page needs. #26991's triage (`6457844993`) and #26767's thread both name this ui consumer as the follow-up. Filed by the `domain:server` seat 2 (`session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo`) for the ui lane to pick up from its own queue. ⛔ Not a claim; left for triage.

## Symptom

An anonymous visitor who opens a share link to a non-chat record at `/s/TOKEN` sees one read-only row per field (since #26767). Each label is the humanized field key ("Annual Revenue"), and each value is formatted only by its JSON shape. So authored field labels, picklist option labels, currency formatting and lookup targets never show.

## What the server now serves

`GET /api/v1/share-links/TOKEN/resolve` answers `{ record, link, redactFields, fields }` on both mounts (`buildShareLinkResolveAnswer`, `packages/types/src/share-link-resolve-answer.ts`). `fields` is keyed by field name and covers exactly the keys `record` carries after redaction. Each entry is a `ShareLinkFieldDisplay`:
- `label` and `type`, as authored;
- `options` (value, label, colour) for a picklist;
- `multiple`;
- `currencyConfig` (`currencyMode`, `defaultCurrency`);
- `reference` (target object) and `displayField` for a lookup.

A lookup's value in `record` is still the stored id. The meta door still refuses an anonymous caller.

## Expected

The shared-record page reads `fields` and renders each row through the record detail view's read-only field renderers: the authored label, picklist option labels, currency formatting and the lookup display. A key with no `fields` entry keeps today's humanized fallback.

## Landing site (the implementer verifies on current `main`)

- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/shared-record-shape.ts`: the `WireResolvedShare` fold gains `fields`.
- `SharedRecordFields.tsx`: renders through the read-only renderers.

## Filing facts

- reach: every share link to a record of any object other than `ai_conversations`.
- Relation: follow-up of #26767 (closed) and #26991 / PR #27107 (merged).
- Dedupe: listed open `domain:ui` issues with "share" / "shared" in the title: #27052, #26844 and #25915, none of which is this.
